smoke_searches.name: metrics_ingestion
smoke_searches.query: search index=host_metrics earliest=-5m | stats latest(_time) AS latest | eval pass=if(isnotnull(latest) AND now()-latest<180,1,0)

smoke_searches.name: journal_ingestion
smoke_searches.query: search index=host_os earliest=-15m | stats latest(_indextime) AS latest | eval pass=if(isnotnull(latest) AND now()-latest<600,1,0)

smoke_searches.name: ai_sysadmin_health_freshness
smoke_searches.query: search index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:health earliest=-8d | stats latest(_time) as latest | eval pass=if(isnotnull(latest) AND now()-latest<691200,1,0)

smoke_searches.name: ai_sysadmin_audit_and_health
smoke_searches.query: search index=ai_sysadmin (sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:audit OR sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:health) earliest=-8d | stats dc(sourcetype) as sources | eval pass=if(sources=2,1,0)
